decisions.decision: Add a repository-root .gitleaks.toml whose allowlist is scoped to the .agents/v2/evidence/ path and to a 64-hex-digest pattern under the generic-api-key rule, instead of disabling the rule or the secrets target.
decisions.rationale: Committed evidence records must contain component evidence keys and artifact digests, which are 64-hex strings indistinguishable from a generic API key by entropy alone. Narrowing by path and pattern keeps every other path and rule enforcing.

decisions.decision: Make the secret scan part of continuous integration by running it unconditionally in .github/workflows/ci.yml rather than attaching it to a component check.
decisions.rationale: Measured gap: ci.yml runs only make affected and make candidate-affected, and no component check runs gitleaks, so the secrets gate existed only on a developer machine. A history-wide scan is not component-scoped, so a workflow step is the correct boundary.

decisions.decision: Amend the two-commit attestation protocol in validation.md 11 so that commit B is validated with make check, not only make candidate.
decisions.rationale: gitleaks git scans committed history, so an uncommitted artifact is never scanned. Validating the attestation before committing it is what let 24 findings reach the branch.

decisions.decision: Record the serial-push rule and the known deploy workflow defect in docs/operations/v2-task-dag.md.
decisions.rationale: verify-parent-ci.sh requires the parent commit to already hold a successful attestation, so pushing two checkpoints back to back fails spuriously. The deploy workflow pins a non-existent action revision and belongs to the M2 scope; both facts must survive outside a conversation.

decisions.decision: Give .gitleaks.toml an owning component in ci/components.json rather than leaving it unowned.
decisions.rationale: make ownership fails on any tracked file with no owning component; the file belongs with the validation toolchain of the environment component.

risks: An allowlist that is too broad would silence real findings on evidence paths; it must be pattern-scoped as well as path-scoped.
gitleaks configuration discovery differs between invocations; the config must be proven effective by running the scan from the repository root as make secrets does.
Changing ci/components.json invalidates every component evidence key, so the candidate aggregate must be regenerated afterwards.
